season.name: Summer
season.line: Labor without Sabbath becomes bondage, however fruitful it looks.

movement.name: The Long Day
movement.line: Endurance is the work of wisdom.

x: Wisdom has built a house for herself, and set up seven pillars.

days.t: The fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom
x: The fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom, and the counsel of saints is understanding:

days.t: Trust in God with all your heart
x: Trust in God with all thine heart; and be not exalted in thine own wisdom.
In all thy ways acquaint thyself with her, that she may rightly direct thy paths.

days.t: If any of you lacks wisdom, let him ask
x: Now if any of you⁺ lacks wisdom, let him ask from God, the One giving generously to all and not reproaching, and it will be given to him.
For she is the brightness of the everlasting light, the unspotted mirror of the power of God, and the image of his goodness.

days.t: If you desire wisdom, keep the commandments
x: If thou desire wisdom, keep the commandments, and the Lord shall give her unto thee.
